title: Seeds of Aqeedah: The First Introduction to Allah
description: A 4-lesson path that introduces the child (ages 4-6) to their Lord in an endearing, tangible way: Allah the Creator, the Bestower, love for Him and His vision, and love for the Prophet ﷺ — the first seeds of aqeedah.

primary_reference.info: ثلاثة الأصول والقواعد الأربع لابن عثيمين، العقيدة الطحاوية، أسئلة الأطفال الإيمانية، أصول الإيمان على فهم السلف

review_defects.why: The Arabic explicitly describes the lessons as 'قصيرة' (short), which is omitted in the English translation. This detail is relevant for the target age group (4-6) and the endearing, tangible approach.
